criteria.detail: Mapping: every hoard rises and the probability is below 0.05 -> B; every hoard falls and the probability is below 0.05 -> C; anything else -> unread; the cell is claimed only if every reference stock gives the same verdict. Counted war-to-peace steps (D to E, F to G), by reference stock. common stock (482834 coins): Xixia 6 of 6 steps, 3 of 3 hoards with every counted step rising (Sato 2021 t3 #14 賀養山大風溝: 1.20, -, 1.52, 0.87, 1.03, 0.79, 0.95, 0.31 | Sato 2021 t3 #15 賀養山楡樹台: 1.08, 0.45, 1.44, 0.97, 1.00, 0.86, 0.94, 0.57 | Sato 2021 t3 #16 衢州市武威地区師範学校: 1.36, -, 1.68, 0.79, 0.92, 0.61, 1.12, 0.78); the same steps in the other hoards against the same stock, a hoard pooled in it taken out: Jin territory 18 of 34 steps, 5 of 18 hoards with every counted step rising; Southern Song territory 13 of 18 steps, 6 of 9 hoards with every counted step rising; Liao 0 of 4 steps, 0 of 3 hoards with every counted step rising; rival's bound for a hoard 0.50, probability 0.125. Southern Song home stock (46919 coins): Xixia 2 of 6 steps, 0 of 3 hoards with every counted step rising (Sato 2021 t3 #14 賀養山大風溝: 1.46, -, 1.66, 0.87, 0.88, 0.69, 0.69, 0.23 | Sato 2021 t3 #15 賀養山楡樹台: 1.31, 0.25, 1.57, 0.97, 0.85, 0.75, 0.68, 0.41 | Sato 2021 t3 #16 衢州市武威地区師範学校: 1.65, -, 1.83, 0.79, 0.78, 0.53, 0.81, 0.57); the same steps in the other hoards against the same stock, a hoard pooled in it taken out: Jin territory 10 of 34 steps, 1 of 18 hoards with every counted step rising; Southern Song territory 9 of 18 steps, 2 of 9 hoards with every counted step rising; Liao 0 of 4 steps, 0 of 3 hoards with every counted step rising; rival's bound for a hoard 0.50, probability 1.000. The hoard is the unit and the steps of one hoard are not separate trials: three hoards give at best 0.125, and 5 hoards all rising would be needed. The common stock without its largest hoard (Sato 2021 t3 #23 石家庄市獲鹿県磚廠, 201194 coins, 42% of it): Xixia 5 of 6 steps, 2 of 3 hoards with every counted step rising. Hoard by hoard, among the hoards of each home territory: E over D, coin counts: Xixia 0.470, 0.411, 0.464; Jin territory median 0.384 over 18 hoards, above each Xixia hoard 3, 5, 3, chance of ranking this high 0.062; Southern Song territory median 0.460 over 9 hoards, above each Xixia hoard 4, 7, 4, chance of ranking this high 0.636; G over F, coin counts: Xixia 2.650, 2.386, 4.000; Jin territory median 2.439 over 16 hoards, above each Xixia hoard 7, 8, 2, chance of ranking this high 0.244; Southern Song territory median 2.704 over 9 hoards, above each Xixia hoard 5, 6, 0, chance of ranking this high 0.364; share of group A: Xixia 0.357, 0.321, 0.404; Jin territory median 0.318 over 18 hoards, above each Xixia hoard 1, 8, 0, chance of ranking this high 0.040; Southern Song territory median 0.256 over 9 hoards, above each Xixia hoard 0, 1, 0, chance of ranking this high 0.009; share of group C: Xixia 0.061, 0.058, 0.067; Jin territory median 0.052 over 18 hoards, above each Xixia hoard 2, 5, 2, chance of ranking this high 0.040; Southern Song territory median 0.038 over 9 hoards, above each Xixia hoard 1, 1, 1, chance of ranking this high 0.032; share of group H: Xixia 0.030, 0.054, 0.074; Jin territory median 0.080 over 18 hoards, below each Xixia hoard 1, 3, 6, chance of ranking this low 0.050; Southern Song territory median 0.143 over 9 hoards, below each Xixia hoard 0, 0, 0, chance of ranking this low 0.004. Pooled ratio by segment against the common stock (Xixia coins): A peace 1004-1053 1.16 (4463); B war 1040-1048 0.17 (1); C peace 1054-1063 1.50 (774); D war 1064-1085 0.90 (3746); E peace 1086-1097 1.01 (1672); F war 1098-1100 0.81 (144); G peace 1101 0.96 (376); H late 1102-1126 0.44 (536). A segment is a group of reign titles and a coin is dated no finer than its title; war years inside each title, then the share of the group's coin cast in war years if each title's coin is spread evenly over its years, with the lowest and highest share any spread allows: A peace 1004-1053 (景德 1004-1007 war years 0 of 4, 祥符 1008-1016 war years 0 of 9, 天禧 1017-1021 war years 0 of 5, 天圣 1023-1031 war years 0 of 9, 明道 1032-1033 war years 0 of 2, 景祐 1034-1037 war years 0 of 4, 皇宋 1039-1053 war years 5 of 15) 0.12 [0.00, 0.36]; B war 1040-1048 (康定 1040-1040 war years 1 of 1, 庆历 1041-1048 war years 4 of 8) 0.50 [0.00, 1.00]; C peace 1054-1063 (至和 1054-1055 war years 0 of 2, 嘉祐 1056-1063 war years 0 of 8) 0.00 [0.00, 0.00]; D war 1064-1085 (治平 1064-1067 war years 4 of 4, 熙宁 1068-1077 war years 7 of 10, 元丰 1078-1085 war years 5 of 8) 0.70 [0.11, 1.00]; E peace 1086-1097 (元祐 1086-1093 war years 0 of 8, 绍圣 1094-1097 war years 2 of 4) 0.15 [0.00, 0.29]; F war 1098-1100 (元符 1098-1100 war years 2 of 3) 0.67 [0.00, 1.00]; G peace 1101 (圣宋 1101-1101 war years 0 of 1) 0.00 [0.00, 0.00]; H late 1102-1126 (崇宁 1102-1106 war years 0 of 5, 大观 1107-1110 war years 0 of 4, 政和 1111-1117 war years 4 of 7, 重和 1118-1118 war years 1 of 1, 宣和 1119-1125 war years 1 of 7, 靖康 1126-1126 war years 0 of 1) 0.25 [0.00, 0.57]. The step out of segment B is not counted: B is one coin, the Qingli ten-cash piece (1 Xixia coin, about 6 expected at the common stock's share), scarce in the north whatever the border did, and that step rises in 9 of 10 Jin-territory hoards against the Southern Song home stock. The late group (cast 1102-1126) is low in every Xixia hoard: little open time before 1127, and after 1127 the route ran through Jin, whose coin bans cut it. Under the Song shi account of the trading posts alone (closed from early Jiayou to 1067), Jiayou coin (1.50) falls in a closed spell; the war and peace reading is taken because a closed post without war moved trade into smuggling (Chen Xu 2005). Northern Song coin in hoards sealed under the Northern Song, outside both stocks: Sato 2021 t3 #1 臨城県臨城鎮北街 307; Sato 2021 t3 #2 汨羅市呂仙村 4107
